name: recent_activity
description: List commits on HEAD from the last N days, newest first. Optionally filter by author (case-sensitive substring of the author name) and/or a repository-relative path.

arguments.name: repo
arguments.desc: Repo name or path; defaults to the first configured repo.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Time window in days.

arguments.name: author
arguments.desc: Only commits whose author name contains this text.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Only commits touching this file or directory.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of results.

name: commit_search
description: Search commit messages (subject and body) on HEAD for a literal, case-insensitive text, newest first. Useful for finding when and why something changed, e.g. a ticket id, a feature name or "revert". Optionally limited to a time window, author and/or path.

arguments.name: repo
arguments.desc: Repo name or path; defaults to the first configured repo.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Text to look for in commit messages.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Only search the last N days. Omit to search the whole history.

arguments.name: author
arguments.desc: Only commits whose author name contains this text.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Only commits touching this file or directory.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of results.

name: file_history
description: List the commits on HEAD that changed a single file, newest first, following the file across renames. Each commit includes the path it had then and lines added/removed. Useful for "how did this file evolve?" and "who reworked it, and when?".

arguments.name: repo
arguments.desc: Repo name or path; defaults to the first configured repo.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Repository-relative path of a single file, as named at HEAD.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of results.

name: file_hotspots
description: Rank files by how many commits changed them in the last N days (merge commits excluded), with how many of those commits were fixes. Pass types: ["fix"] to rank by bug fixes only and find the files that keep breaking. Useful for spotting churn, risky areas and refactoring candidates.

arguments.name: repo
arguments.desc: Repo name or path; defaults to the first configured repo.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Time window in days.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Restrict to this file or directory.

arguments.name: exclude
arguments.desc: Glob patterns for files to leave out, e.g. ["*.lock", "dist/", "docs/**/*.md"]. A pattern without "/" matches at any depth; a trailing "/" excludes a directory.

arguments.name: types
arguments.desc: Only count commits of these conventional-commit types, e.g. ["fix"]. Commits without a type count as "fix" when their subject mentions fix, bug or hotfix.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of results.

name: change_coupling
description: Find pairs of files that are often changed in the same commits in the last N days (merge commits excluded), most shared commits first. Reveals hidden dependencies that imports do not show, e.g. code and the config or test it always drags along. Pass "file" to see what usually changes together with one file.

arguments.name: repo
arguments.desc: Repo name or path; defaults to the first configured repo.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Time window in days.

arguments.name: file
arguments.desc: Only pairs that include this repository-relative file.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Restrict to this file or directory.

arguments.name: exclude
arguments.desc: Globs to leave out, as in file_hotspots.

arguments.name: minShared
arguments.desc: Minimum number of shared commits for a pair to be listed.

arguments.name: maxFilesPerCommit
arguments.desc: Skip commits touching more files than this (bulk renames, formatting).

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of results.

name: list_tags
description: List tags (releases) newest first with their date and tagged commit, plus the latest tag reachable from HEAD and how many commits were made since it (unreleased work). Use it to find tag names for release_notes_draft or compare_refs.

arguments.name: repo
arguments.desc: Repo name or path; defaults to the first configured repo.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of results.

name: release_notes_draft
description: Group commits between two refs by conventional-commit type (breaking changes, features, fixes, ...) as a Markdown draft, or as structured sections. "from" defaults to the latest tag before "to"; without any tag, all commits up to "to" are used. To draft notes for an existing release, pass its tag as "to" (see list_tags).

arguments.name: repo
arguments.desc: Repo name or path; defaults to the first configured repo.

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: Start ref, exclusive (tag, branch or commit).

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: End ref, inclusive.

arguments.name: format
arguments.desc: "markdown" for a ready-to-paste draft, "sections" for structured data.

name: compare_refs
description: Compare two refs (branches, tags or commits): how many commits "head" is ahead of and behind "base", and which commits those are, newest first. Useful for "how far behind main is my branch?" or "what is on this branch that is not released yet?".

arguments.name: repo
arguments.desc: Repo name or path; defaults to the first configured repo.

arguments.name: base
arguments.desc: Ref to compare against, e.g. "main" or a tag.

arguments.name: head
arguments.desc: Ref to compare, e.g. a branch.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of results.

name: stale_branches
description: List branches whose latest commit is at least N days old, oldest first, and whether each is already merged into HEAD.

arguments.name: repo
arguments.desc: Repo name or path; defaults to the first configured repo.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Time window in days.

arguments.name: includeRemote
arguments.desc: Also include remote-tracking branches.

arguments.name: mergedOnly
arguments.desc: Only list branches already merged into HEAD, i.e. safe cleanup candidates.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of results.

name: knowledge_map
description: Who knows a file or directory: each author's share of the knowledge, from the commits they made in the last N days (merge commits excluded), with recent commits weighted more. Also returns the bus factor and how many files depend on a single person. Useful for "who should review this?" and "who knows the auth module best?".

arguments.name: repo
arguments.desc: Repo name or path; defaults to the first configured repo.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Restrict to this file or directory.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Time window in days.

arguments.name: halfLifeDays
arguments.desc: A commit counts half as much for every this many days of age.

arguments.name: exclude
arguments.desc: Globs to leave out, as in file_hotspots.

arguments.name: maxFilesPerCommit
arguments.desc: Skip commits touching more files than this (bulk renames, formatting).

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of results.

name: review_context
description: Review briefing for the changes in base..head (e.g. a branch or pull request): the changed files ranked by how often they changed and broke on base, files that usually change together with them but were left out (a forgotten test, config or caller), and who knows the changed files best as suggested reviewers. Merge commits are excluded.

arguments.name: repo
arguments.desc: Repo name or path; defaults to the first configured repo.

arguments.name: base
arguments.desc: Target ref the changes would merge into, e.g. "main".

arguments.name: head
arguments.desc: Ref with the changes, e.g. a branch.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Time window in days.

arguments.name: halfLifeDays
arguments.desc: For reviewers: a commit counts half as much for every this many days of age.

arguments.name: exclude
arguments.desc: Globs to leave out, as in file_hotspots.

arguments.name: minShared
arguments.desc: Minimum shared commits for a missing companion.

arguments.name: minDegree
arguments.desc: Minimum coupling degree (percentage) for a missing companion.

arguments.name: maxFilesPerCommit
arguments.desc: Skip history commits touching more files than this (bulk renames, formatting).

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of results.

name: code_age
description: How long ago each file on HEAD last changed, oldest first, with its last author and whether that author still commits to the repository. Also returns an age histogram, the median age per directory and how many files were last touched by someone who has left. Useful for "which parts of the code nobody touches any more?" and "where are we losing knowledge?".

arguments.name: repo
arguments.desc: Repo name or path; defaults to the first configured repo.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Restrict to this file or directory.

arguments.name: minAgeDays
arguments.desc: Only list files at least this many days old (the summary covers all files).

arguments.name: inactiveDays
arguments.desc: An author with no commit in this many days counts as inactive.

arguments.name: exclude
arguments.desc: Globs to leave out, as in file_hotspots.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of results.

name: contributor_summary
description: Count commits per author on HEAD in the last N days, most active first. Optionally restricted to a path.

arguments.name: repo
arguments.desc: Repo name or path; defaults to the first configured repo.

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Time window in days.

arguments.name: includeMerges
arguments.desc: Count merge commits too.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Restrict to this file or directory.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of results.
